interpretation.what_is_now_supported: The source-data workbook contains physiology rows explicitly labeled S10_2, S11_2, and S12_2, establishing sample-level provenance for the three GSE234907 3D RNA samples.
interpretation.what_is_not_supported: The workbook does not contain the RNA IDs S7_2, S8_2, or S9_2, so a complete six-sample paired RNA-to-physiology analysis is not yet justified.
interpretation.allowed_next_analysis: Run a leakage-safe paired RNA-to-physiology analysis for the three explicitly linked 3D samples only, clearly labeled as n=3 exploratory validation; do not infer 2D physiology links from row order or class labels.
interpretation.remaining_gap: Identify the physiology experimental-unit identifiers corresponding to S7_2, S8_2, and S9_2, or obtain a source manifest that maps those GEO samples to the workbook units.
